implementation_state.NOT_STARTED: No repository implementation is content-bound to the task.
implementation_state.PARTIAL: Some repository implementation is content-bound, with explicit blockers.
implementation_state.IMPLEMENTED: The repository implementation is content-bound; execution evidence remains separate.
implementation_state.BLOCKED: Implementation cannot proceed until explicit blockers are resolved.

execution_state.NOT_RUN: No exact repository result receipt has been executed and bound.
execution_state.PASS: Exact execution passed with content-addressed, replayable evidence and zero skipped tests.
execution_state.FAIL: Exact execution produced a failing result receipt.
execution_state.INCONCLUSIVE: Execution occurred but cannot support pass or fail.

evidence_state.LOCAL_SELF_ATTESTED: Local evidence is content-bound but not independently verified.
evidence_state.LOCAL_INDEPENDENT: Local evidence has distinct executor and verifier.
evidence_state.EXTERNAL_INDEPENDENT: Authorized external evidence has distinct executor and verifier.
